falseSynonyms.zh: 有趣不等於 enjoyable interesting 表示能引起注意或思考；有些有趣內容可以令人不安，未必令人享受。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interesting holds attention; enjoyable gives pleasure.

falseSynonyms.zh: 刺激不等於 enjoyable exciting 強調興奮和刺激；愉快的體驗不一定令人興奮。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Exciting is high-energy; enjoyable can be calm.

falseSynonyms.zh: 舒適不等於 enjoyable comfortable 表示身體或心理舒適；舒服的椅子不是『令人享受的活動』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Comfort is one possible source of enjoyment, not the same concept.

falseSynonyms.zh: 好笑不等於 enjoyable funny 強調幽默／令人發笑；enjoyable 可以完全不涉及笑。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Funny is about humour; enjoyable is broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 容易不等於 enjoyable easy 描述難度低；一件容易的工作仍可能非常沉悶。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ease and enjoyment are different.

falseSynonyms.zh: 受歡迎不等於 enjoyable popular 表示很多人喜歡；不能單靠受歡迎程度證明某個人覺得享受。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Popularity is social approval, not personal enjoyment.

falseSynonyms.zh: 成功不等於 enjoyable successful 表示達成目標；成功的活動過程仍可能壓力很大。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Success concerns outcomes; enjoyment concerns experience.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 enjoy 是動詞；enjoyable 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Enjoy is a verb; enjoyable is an adjective.
